summary: Shared agent workflows for Claude Code and Codex, covering PR review, PR triage, post-gate security and quality review, documentation sync, Kubernetes platform audit, codebase prune, MikroTik RouterOS reference, tvOS SwiftUI, macOS SwiftUI, and context optimisation. Canonical logic lives in shared/; commands/ and skills/ are thin adapters for their respective platforms. Scripts provide standalone harvesters and payload builders used by the heavier workflows.
entrypoints: commands/{workflow}.md: Claude Code slash command, invoked as /claude-skills:{workflow}
skills/{workflow}/SKILL.md: Codex skill, invoked by skill name
scripts/build-review-payload.py: standalone payload builder for pr-review
scripts/docs-audit.py: standalone docs auditor for docs-update
scripts/k8s-harvest.sh: standalone cluster harvester for k8s-audit
scripts/cruft-harvest.sh: standalone repo harvester for codebase-prune

shared.purpose: Canonical workflow logic. Authoritative source for both platforms. Edit here first.

commands.purpose: Claude Code slash command adapters (namespace: claude-skills). Each file delegates to shared/. Two deprecated aliases forward to renamed workflows.

skills.purpose: Codex skill adapters. Each subdirectory contains SKILL.md delegating to shared/.

scripts.purpose: Standalone harvesters and payload builders. Stdlib-only Python 3; no pip install required. Never writes inside the target repo; never installs anything.
exports: build-review-payload.py: assembles GitHub review payload for pr-review (optional; pr-review falls back if missing)
docs-audit.py: mechanical docs audit for docs-update
k8s-harvest.sh: read-only cluster dump for k8s-audit; never harvests secret values
cruft-harvest.sh: read-only repo dump for codebase-prune; universe is git ls-files

claude-plugin.purpose: Claude Code plugin manifests. marketplace.json for registry; plugin.json defines the claude-skills plugin (version 0.6.0). Namespace stays claude-skills for backward compatibility.

codex-plugin.purpose: Codex plugin manifest. plugin.json defines the agent-skills Codex plugin (version 1.5.0).

callgraph_highlights.note: shared/pr-review.md optionally uses scripts/build-review-payload.py; falls back to hand-written payload when missing
shared/docs-update.md uses scripts/docs-audit.py for the mechanical audit half
shared/k8s-audit.md uses scripts/k8s-harvest.sh for the single read-only cluster harvest
shared/codebase-prune.md uses scripts/cruft-harvest.sh for the read-only repo dump
shared/mikrotik-routeros.md is a dispatch page; the agent loads only the deeper mikrotik/ file it needs
All Codex skills follow the same delegation pattern as their commands/ counterparts

conventions.naming: Workflows follow {noun}-{verb}. New workflows must be complete across all three layers: shared/, commands/, skills/.
conventions.backwards_compat: Claude command namespace stays claude-skills. Do not change.
conventions.deprecated_aliases: tvos-swiftui -> swiftui-build, update-docs -> docs-update. Forward only; will be removed in a future release.
conventions.scripts: Stdlib-only Python 3. Never add pip or external dependencies.
conventions.idempotent: All workflows are idempotent. Second run merges, does not duplicate or clobber.
conventions.plugin_versions: Claude plugin and Codex plugin have separate version numbers. Bump both on release.
